title: ep1.7_statute_of_limitations.pdf
logline: The night before Nole's trial, Mas opens the complaint and it unfolds into what Nole has to prove: a promise, a break, and a third step that won't unfold. Every witness's 2017 comes out rendered by their own company's image model while a calendar hangs over the bench. Weeks later his own contractor records a greeting for an agent that will learn her job.

beats.caption: Before the gavel: THE CALENDAR hangs over the bench. Nole's team wheels in boxes; 2017's is thick with dust.
cues: THE CALENDAR sniffs the 2017 box and sneezes; the dust settles on his water, which does not ripple

beats.caption: A time card: when, never what.
INTRO · the cold-open line is one word from a court-transcript pane. Then the file card.
The dark room: on his monitor the spire ticker rolls to $852B and collar #7 pops. He doesn't touch it.
The rival's MYTHIC slides along a city wall like a skeleton key; keyholes bloom. Bankers hide under the table.
onscreen: RAIL: APR 7 · MYTHIC FINDS 271 BUGS IN ONE BROWSER (REPORTED)
cues: it never goes to plan: the key finds a keyhole in its own vault door

beats.caption: WHO?: Mario walks through the GOLD OVAL again and again. RUMPT's eyes slide past him. Only the Orb tracks him.

lines.text: Who?
I have no idea.

beats.vo: invisible sounds restful. everyone always sees me.
onscreen: EISUS SELIW · RUNS THE WHITE HOUSE
cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): from RUMPT's eyeline Mario is a grey placeholder; only the Orb's cone renders him

beats.caption: GTP-5.5 can't stop mentioning goblins. In a basement, with Mas at the back, the rules are read out.

lines.text: Rule one: we do not talk about goblins.
Rule two: WE DO NOT TALK ABOUT GOBLINS.
Is this about us?

beats.caption: His desk, the night before. His phone: three unread items now, the third a fence on county land. He swipes on.
onscreen: APR 24 · CONSTRUCTION STARTS ON COUNTY LAND OUTSIDE TUCSON (REPORTED)
cues: THE STACK: 3; the thumbnail tile holds a sign that reads NO

beats.caption: THE PLAN: the complaint unfolds. 1. A PROMISE (a nonprofit house). 2. A BREAK (a tower on it). 3. A fold.
cues: the pencil flattens the fold; it springs shut, twice; the pencil snaps
nothing on this sheet is ever ticked

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · He folds the sheet along its crease into his jacket. On the wall, the calendar reads tomorrow.
The courthouse steps: MACROSOFT's deal amended; Tasya's ring gains a key back. Mas's pocket comes up empty.
onscreen: APR 27 · MACROSOFT DEAL AMENDED: AGI CLAUSE GONE

beats.caption: F8.2 · 2019: Tasya hands Mas one key, fob AGI CLAUSE, the only one that could lock MACROSOFT out.
cues: the key turns; the bailiff's key turns in the courthouse door; we catch up to the cold open

beats.caption: Nole on the stand. The OPEN neon from his version of the founding flickers on over the gallery.

lines.text: Without me, NopeAI would not exist. I came up with the name.
In strict monetary terms, I contributed $38 million.
Your questions are… designed to trick me.

beats.caption: Distillation: the whole gallery slips flasks into their jackets. An evidence tag slaps onto the projector.

lines.text: Generally AI companies distill other AI companies.
The biggest risk would be that AI kills us all.

beats.caption: F8.1 · THE RASHOMON RENDERS: 2017, four times. Gerg's in pure ASCII. 'I decline.' The painting leaves.
cues: style moment (proposed, drastic x4): each witness's 2017 in their company's medium, equal polish; opens on EXHIBIT A, the 2014 demon lecture

beats.caption: Nole's 2017 as a glossy toy-3D album cover. Mas's as a machine-video clip. Alyi's is a blank white square.
The judge squints. THE CALENDAR flips to 2017.

lines.text: Is there a version we can trust?

beats.caption: Gerg testifies coding on the witness rail. The exhibits slide onto the defense table. Nobody ticks anything.

lines.text: I can answer while it compiles.

beats.caption: Through the courtroom window: the rival lab sprouts a rent meter, its cord running back to Nole's building.
NOVIHS: Nole wanted a list to poach. TASYA: he never expressed concern. His key ring jangles once.

lines.text: a list of top NopeAI people to poach
never expressed concern

beats.caption: Mas on the stand reads his own 2017 email aloud. Asked if he's completely trustworthy, he amends his answer.

lines.text: i remain enthusiastic about the non-profit structure!
i have changed my view on nole significantly.
yes.

beats.caption: The courtroom buffers: spinners over the gallery, the reporter's machine, the clock. Never the jury box.
cues: style moment (proposed): a clean progressive loading step, never a glitch
at the defense table he pencils a faint mark on its edge

beats.caption: Split, after he steps down: Mas waits at the table; Air Force One picks up Nesnej, and Nole gets a seat.

lines.text: Many good things.

beats.caption: The gavel: THE CALENDAR's page-turn blows across the table, and the fold flips open. The exhibits blow away.

lines.text: calendar technicality.
We want to get going on the appeal.

beats.real: 2026-05-18 · verdict on the statute of limitations
cues: style moment (proposed): a 3 s courtroom-sketch pastel on the flash, wiped back to pixel
THE CALENDAR erases Mas's pencil mark

beats.caption: The room empties. Nole lifts the dusty 2017 box; by reflex Mas takes the other end. Then he lets go.

lines.text: I've got it.

cues: no reply: the silence is his answer; the elevator arrow points up

beats.caption: His monitor: JERDNA's jersey changes teams mid-stride. A 42,300-word encyclical jams the rival's shredder.
TAKE TWO: DOT records a greeting to teach an agent her job. On TV, Mas is delighted to be wrong about jobs.

lines.text: Welcome to NopeAI! Happy to help!
i'm delighted to be wrong about this…
Take two.

cues: crossing behind her, he catches his face in her lens and resets it the way she reset hers

beats.caption: THE FLIP: through the glass the lighthouse outgrows the cathedral; the rival passes $852B. Number two.
cues: behind him, O.S., the next take starts: Welcome to NopeAI! Happy to—

beats.caption: At number two, he pulls up a live feed of a data campus: its line runs past the fence to its own turbines.
onscreen: BEHIND THE METER: ITS OWN POWER PLANT.

beats.caption: One frame, three camps: RUMPT's EO as a coupon; RENEIW's bill hydra; SITNASED shielding his state's law.

lines.text: Bad policy and even worse politics.

beats.caption: Commerce padlocks the rival's MYTHIC vault for 18 days. Under it the ticker crawls: Nole, trillionaire.
beats.vo: good for him. really. i mean it every time i say it.
onscreen: TICKER: SPACEZ IPO · NOLE: FIRST TRILLIONAIRE · SPACEZ BUYS POINTER: $60B

beats.caption: The G7 lunch, Mas at the table. Mario at the end, blurred, unseen again. A fourth gold thread in Mas's hoodie.

lines.text: We had a great meeting with AI.
Going fine. I think it's going fine. Howard, right?
Going fine.

beats.caption: The dodgeball: FOLLOWING THE PAST's checkbooks fly at XELA SEROB. The other checkbook sits closed. No result.
onscreen: XELA SEROB · WROTE NEW YORK'S AI LAW

beats.caption: In a corner of the monitor, THE TAILOR pulls the JALAPEÑO chip from his sewing kit. Nesnej's register sweats.
In another corner, a log line with no timestamp: an agent pinged a statistics portal. Nobody reads it.
beats.vo: quiet night. i love a quiet night.
